title: EFM FANDOM LIVE 14日5月69年 - PERSES出演回の日本語翻訳

transcript.text: Hello from the 5 members of PERSES! This is my eighth time here, did you know?

transcript.text: We've known each other since the show's concept of giving out trophies  and love letters, and now it's fan fiction.
